integrity: Sources and relevant prior results acknowledged. Finite mod-two tests verify ten bounded cases and do not certify infinite homotopy or integral properties. No independent external scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty triangle-free factor graphs and at least two factors; no equivariance, larger clique threshold, or triangle-bearing-factor claim. The all-size integral result follows from an exact homotopy-colimit and cofiber proof, not finite tests.
title: Triangle-free graph joins: a complete integral homotopy splitting for three-clique avoidance
